title: Netpbm before 10.86.51, 11.x before 11.02.29, and 11.03 before 11.15.07 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in…
description: A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in Netpbm's sgitopnm readChannels() function when processing RLE-compressed SGI images. This affects versions before 10.86.51, all 11.x versions before 11.02.29, and 11.03 versions before 11.15.07. Crafted SGI files with oversized offset table lengths can cause memory corruption, leading to crashes or potential code execution.
